doc_sources.title: Pydantic Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The root URL https://pydantic.dev/docs is the official documentation site for Pydantic, providing the latest version of the docs. It is the primary entry point recommended by the project and is more authoritative than language‑specific mirrors or deep links. The site is directly owned by the Pydantic maintainers, making it the best choice for a canonical documentation source.

doc_sources.title: HTTPX – A next-generation HTTP client for Python
doc_sources.rationale: https://www.python-httpx.org is the official documentation site maintained by the httpx developers. It serves as the primary entry point for the library’s docs, matching the library name and providing comprehensive reference material. Other results refer to a different tool (projectdiscovery/httpx) or third‑party tutorials, making this the most appropriate choice.
